purpose: Teach: 非合法/謀略/疎外/破裂/充満/退学/単発/創世

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、非合法な活動を行った組織の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, in your paper you examined organizations that engaged in illegal activities, didn't you?
lines.style: Steady, curious tone. Professional but warm — asking to confirm, not to challenge. Even pace, slight lean into the question. Genuinely interested in her answer.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、政治的謀略の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I focused on the history of political conspiracies.
lines.style: Direct, clear statement. Slight formality — she's speaking to a teacher. Not hesitant, but not over-confident either. Measured delivery, ending flat and factual.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 社会的に疎外された人々の心理を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And in another paper, you studied the psychology of socially marginalized groups, correct?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Gentle, almost musing tone — she's drawing connections. Not interrogating, but reflecting back what she's noticing. Slow, deliberate pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、配管が破裂した事故を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. That one examined the aftermath of a major infrastructure failure.
lines.style: Calm, direct response. She's meeting the teacher's observations head-on without defensiveness. Steady breath, matter-of-fact tone. Brief, anchored.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 煙が充満した火災現場の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you researched disaster scenes where smoke and toxic conditions were the central factors?
lines.style: Slightly more engaged now — she's picked up on a pattern. Warm curiosity, not suspicion. Voice carries a hint of recognition. Even pacing, attentive.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、退学者の社会復帰を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I looked at how people in that situation rebuild their lives after leaving.
lines.style: Steady, grounded answer. She's being forthright. No apology in her voice, no over-explanation. Direct eye-contact level delivery. Slight weight to the words.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 単発の事件と連続事件の比較を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Your final paper compared isolated incidents to patterns across multiple events, didn't it?
lines.style: Reflective, almost gently wondering aloud. She's drawing the last thread together. Measured, appreciative tone — no judgment, just recognition. Slight questioning lilt at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、創世神話の比較研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes. I did a comparative study of creation myths.
lines.style: Clear, final answer. She meets the implication without flinching. Grounded, present. A subtle firmness underneath the calm — not defensive, but complete. Breath settles at the end.
